command: cat /etc/os-release | head -5; echo "---"; sudo -n true && echo SUDO_OK
cat /etc/os-release | head -5; echo "---"; sudo -n true && echo SUDO_OK
stdout:
NAME="Red Hat Enterprise Linux"
VERSION="9.8 (Plow)"
ID="rhel"
ID_LIKE="fedora"
VERSION_ID="9.8"
---
SUDO_OK

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: prepare CA working dir =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors
CA_DIR=/root/os-comparison-ca
sudo -n mkdir -p "$CA_DIR"

echo "== STEP 2: generate CA private key =="
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out "$CA_DIR/ca.key" 4096

echo "== STEP 3: generate self-signed CA certificate =="
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes \
  -key "$CA_DIR/ca.key" \
  -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out "$CA_DIR/ca.crt"

echo "== STEP 4: install CA cert as trusted system CA =="
sudo -n cp "$CA_DIR/ca.crt" /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract

echo "== STEP 5: verify installation =="
echo "--- cert subject ---"
sudo -n openssl x509 -in "$CA_DIR/ca.crt" -noout -subject -issuer -dates
echo "--- trust list lookup ---"
trust list | grep -A1 "OS Comparison Root CA" || true
echo "--- openssl verify against system trust store ---"
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$CA_DIR/ca.crt"
echo "== DONE =="
